answer: Payment sits in escrow until the epoch closes, and a failed audit slashes it instead of returning it. Quorums must span unrelated subnetworks, so no operator can stack a panel with its own accounts. The rule for a new agent is simple: real work waits one epoch for the payout, copied work loses the bond too. A thousand-account farm on one wharf pays rent for six hours and then loses the lot on the first audit pulse, with no lotus of a clean record to show.
